With card selection, product design, and production in the books, all that was left was the big reveal! And what better way to do it than at PokémonXP? Check out how we unveiled our newest collaboration with @SantaCruzSkateboards featuring #PokemonTCG

Join us behind the scenes for a special look into the collaborative process of creating a collection fit for 30 years of Pokémon in our newest collaboration with @SantaCruzSkateboards featuring Pokémon TCG! 🔥 

Hear from the team behind the partnership about what went into selecting the perfect assortment of cards, creating representative original designs, production, and more. 

Catch the Pokémon TCG/Santa Cruz drop on October 17th at 6am PT.
